name: s2s-rag
description: PDF Document Management with Voice-Based RAG Search

scripts.start:backend:dev:local: rimraf backend/dist && cross-env PORT=3001 yarn workspace backend start:dev
scripts.start:frontend:local: cross-env BACKEND_PORT=3001 yarn workspace frontend dev
scripts.build: yarn workspace backend build && yarn workspace frontend build
scripts.test: yarn workspace backend test && yarn workspace frontend test
scripts.coverage: yarn workspace backend test:cov && yarn workspace frontend coverage
scripts.lint: yarn workspace backend lint && yarn workspace frontend lint
